assets_added.title: Inert-plus terminating Jacobi-jet supercongruence certificate

statement_or_tool_contract.statement: For every prime p congruent to 13 or 19 modulo 24, write p=6m+1. With Phi_m(x,z)=sum_{k=0}^{6m} (-x)_k(-2x)_k z^k/(k!)^2, Psi_m=(1+12 z d/dz)Phi_m, a=Phi/p-Phi_x/6, and the frozen reflected scalar R_p from the Enterprise BRC half-coupling interface, all evaluated at (x,z)=(m,1/2), the terminating certificate (a+p Phi_xx/72)(Psi-p Psi_x/6) congruent 1+p R_p modulo p^2 holds.

assets_added.claim_scope: Only primes p congruent to 13 or 19 modulo 24 and the exact frozen Enterprise BRC half-coupling/Jacobi-jet definitions in the cited artifact. This is the project-facing plus-class a=1 reduction; it does not assert all of Sun A14(ii), all primes, or higher prime powers.

assets_added.promotion_target: Prove the registered all-prime-class certificate, preferably through a terminating creative-microscoping/WZ certificate or an independent Frobenius/Jacobi-sum transversality theorem. Finite regression alone cannot prove the infinite prime-class statement.
assets_added.notes: Registered from an exact internal reduction of an explicitly unproved inherited supercongruence target. The internal reduced certificate, not the entire external conjecture family, is the canonical Enterprise asset.
